verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine that runs on both GPUs and CPUs, so diagnosing a failed GPU initialization and a silent CPU fallback is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents broad hardware support and TTFT/throughput statistics, but nothing about reporting why GPU acceleration failed or flagging a fallback to CPU. Throughput stats are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
